name: Berkshire Trails Camp
description_short: Coed overnight camp in Great Barrington, founded in 1968 as Kutsher's Sports Academy, with sessions of two to seven weeks. Campers pick five classes a week from sports, waterfront, adventure, arts and performing arts.
refund_policy_summary: All fees, deposit included, are fully refundable through January 1; no refunds after January 1.
notes: Rates depend on grade: rising grades 2 to 5 pay $4,995 for two weeks up to $11,955 for seven; rising grades 6 to 11 pay $5,995 up to $14,800. $1,500 deposit per session, $150 sibling discount, optional linen rental $125.
